population: Full sealed train and validation, original multiplicities; no test records
taxonomy: Benign plus every original Attack name in training; no merges

linear.weighting: original multiplicity; SGD order shuffled within compact shard batches, fixed seed

selection: No search or refit; report all four fits and both frozen binary modes. Validation reused exploratorily, no independent selection estimate.

criteria.all_family_go: All original families must meet recall/support gates; rare families block an unqualified GO.
criteria.conditional_go: At least half the attack families meet recall and support gates; an end-to-end candidate meets detection/FPR gates and resource budget. Unsupported families must remain explicit/experimental.
